name: Connivance
overview: The Scriptures reveal the serious consequences of connivance, particularly in the failure to restrain sin within a household, as seen in the judgment pronounced on Eli for allowing his sons to continue in their wickedness without correction. This divine warning underscores that silent complicity or turning a blind eye to iniquity brings sorrow and judgment. Proverbs further illustrates this principle by stating that those who wink with the eye, symbolizing secretive approval or connivance, cause sorrow, contrasting with the downfall of the fool who speaks without discretion.
